title: Tiny, cute bus
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Bus body -->
  <rect x="12" y="35" width="76" height="38" rx="8" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Roof highlight -->
  <rect x="16" y="37" width="68" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFE680"/>
  <!-- Front windshield -->
  <rect x="70" y="42" width="14" height="14" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="72" y="44" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="#A8E0F0"/>
  <!-- Side windows -->
  <rect x="20" y="42" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="20" y="56" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="35" y="42" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="35" y="56" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="50" y="42" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="50" y="56" width="11" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Stripe -->
  <rect x="12" y="61" width="76" height="4" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x="62" y="44" width="8" height="24" rx="2" fill="#8ED4E8"/>
  <rect x="63" y="45" width="6" height="10" rx="1" fill="#B8E8F5"/>
  <rect x="63" y="57" width="6" height="10" rx="1" fill="#B8E8F5"/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="56" r="4" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Bumper -->
  <rect x="10" y="70" width="80" height="5" rx="2" fill="#E8A020"/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="75" r="9" fill="#4A4A8A"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="75" r="5" fill="#8A8AC0"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="75" r="2" fill="#C0C0E8"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="75" r="9" fill="#4A4A8A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="75" r="5" fill="#8A8AC0"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="75" r="2" fill="#C0C0E8"/>
  <!-- Cute eyes on windshield -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M74 51 Q77 53 80 51" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little antenna with heart -->
  <line x1="50" y1="35" x2="50" y2="28" stroke="#FF6B6B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 25 Q47 21 44 24 Q41 27 44 30 L50 35 L56 30 Q59 27 56 24 Q53 21 50 25 Z" fill="#FF4757"/>
</svg>
